author: Zintenka
body:
I made a cool map with great gameplay and awesome terraforming. The good thing about this map to many is that it is smaller than the ones i usually make. 

Also, there is TNT but there is only one chest full of it and it is hidden. You will find this along with a chest of spawn eggs containing 4 creeper eggs, 4 zombie eggs, 4 witch eggs and 4 wolf eggs. Along with 64 bones to make a pack.






Author:

Zintenka

Special Thanks To:

Alex AKA ScriptingLyfe for his build server and for voxel sniper!

Features:

  • 25v25
  • One chest of secret TNT for each side
  • One chest of secret spawn eggs for each side
  • Anyone on the opposite team who enters enemy spawn will suffer entity_explosion_damage (Damage done by TNT or a creeper); prevents spawn killing.
  • A DTM version 4 monuments
  • A CTW version 4 wools
  • 8 xp bottles for each kill
  • The center allows you to shoot fireballs at the other side at a velocity of 5.
  • Regeneration I for everyone

Changelog 1.0

DTM Version:
  • Lava replaced with water
  • Gold replaced with Iron
  • Got rid of CTW chests

DTM Download
